system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Auspex, Basic Celerity, Basic Obfuscate. A trick passed among the Toreador for centuries, Doubletalk lets a character speak a full sentence very quickly and softly between words spoken normally, so it sounds to most listeners like a conversational placeholder ('uh,' 'er,' 'hmmm'). Someone familiar with the power can hear the hidden sentence; true masters can compress entire soliloquies into a single grunt. This is not one of the clan's great secrets — some Tremere and Malkavians have also mastered the technique.

System: To listen for Doubletalk, the player rolls Perception + Subterfuge (difficulty 5); success means the character hears what was said (a failure means nothing heard, a botch means she misinterprets it). To speak Doubletalk, the player rolls Intelligence + Expression (difficulty 6); success lets the character seamlessly insert the phrase (a failure means she isn't understood, a botch means she blurts it out at normal speed).

MET System: Players should agree on a hand signal (such as tugging the left earlobe) to clarify what's spoken normally versus secretly. Listening for Doubletalk requires a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty five Traits); speaking it requires a Static Mental Challenge (difficulty six Traits). A single challenge covers the entire conversation in either case.

Costs five Experience Traits to learn (10 experience points in the tabletop system).
